entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. It's... it's just not working right, and I'm so disappointed. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and this has never happened.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue you're experiencing? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's a fault. The heart rate monitor is all over the place. One minute it says 50, the next it says 180 while I'm just sitting here. Honestly, the tracking is just garbage. I saved up for this, and it's been a real letdown.
I understand your frustration. That certainly doesn't sound right. I can try to walk you through a few troubleshooting steps to see if we can resolve it. It might just be a simple calibration issue.

Oh, I really don't have time for all that. I've already tried turning it off and on. Look, I just want money back. Can we please just start the process for a refund? I really needed that money for other things.

I see. You'd prefer not to troubleshoot and would rather return the item. Let me just pull up your order information to check the return eligibility. Can you confirm the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Sadie. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It was delivered 25 days ago. Let me just check our policy here... Okay, it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're within the 90-day period, I can go ahead and authorize that return for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed.
Wow, that's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried. I really appreciate you making it so easy.
You're very welcome, Sadie. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
